questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure identity, access, and security
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure conditional access
questions.question: Which statement best describes Conditional Access?

options.text: Using identity and device state with tools such as Intune and Conditional Access
A Microsoft Entra policy engine that evaluates sign-in signals and applies access controls
Technology that synchronizes identities between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
Designing detection, segmentation, and response as though attackers may already be present

questions.explanation: Conditional Access is a Microsoft Entra policy engine that evaluates sign-in signals and applies access controls.

questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does User or group signal refer to?

Security posture and protection capabilities that can extend beyond Azure to supported other-cloud environments

questions.explanation: User or group signal is the identity or group membership used as part of a Conditional Access decision.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure identity, access, and security
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure conditional access
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Location signal: verifying the identity of a person, service, or device before granting access.
User or group signal: the identity or group membership used as part of a Conditional Access decision.
Conditional Access: a Microsoft Entra policy engine that evaluates sign-in signals and applies access controls.
Conditional Access: device state or compliance information used in access decisions.
User or group signal: a Conditional Access result that denies access when policy conditions are met.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Conditional Access — a Microsoft Entra policy engine that evaluates sign-in signals and applies access controls; and User or group signal — the identity or group membership used as part of a Conditional Access decision.
